title: Unit Cost Metrics Calculator
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate cost per transaction, cost per query, and cost per user from the running example's operating data, distinguishing fully loaded cost from fees only.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate cost per transaction, cost per query, and cost per user from the running example's operating data, distinguishing fully loaded cost from fees only.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) Fees-only cost equals the full cost per query. (2) Cost per user falls whenever cost per ticket falls. (3) Cost per query and cost per transaction are interchangeable.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of five items the learner types a value before the answer is shown. A value is correct when within $0.0005 of the model value for per-ticket and per-query items and within $1 for the per-user item. Mastery is 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt. Exploration is not evidence.
